cases.prompt: Design SLOs for checkout. Journey: a signed-in customer places an order via POST /api/orders. Last 30 days of load balancer logs: 12.4M eligible requests (health checks and 4xx validation errors excluded), 18,600 returned 5xx, p99 latency 1.8 s, p95 0.6 s. Incidents: 2026-08-03 payments provider outage (45 minutes, 5xx rate 38%) and 2026-08-21 slow database failover (12 minutes, p99 above 5 s). Each failed checkout costs about EUR 62. Owner of budget decisions: Ana, payments team lead. We have no contractual SLA. A synthetic probe hits the endpoint every minute.
sourceAnchors: Choose event or time-based indicators with valid numerator, denominator, eligibility, exclusions, source, latency, and handling of missing telemetry.
Backtest against incidents and healthy periods
